name: filarr-gate-monorepo
description: Filarr Gate: serve a Filarr database as an API, without Filarr ever seeing your data. Monorepo of the library, the server, the Cloudflare variant and the copied Filarr core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @filarr/gate && npm run build -w filarr-gate
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cloudflare/tsconfig.json --noEmit

FILARR_GATE_TOKEN.description: The token Filarr showed once (`flr_live_…`), from "···" › **Open to an API** on a database. It stays a secret of YOUR Cloudflare account.

FILARR_GATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the management UI, served under `/admin/` on this Worker. Ten characters at least.
